text: This report recommends a revised organization structure involving two divisions of Exhibition Place.

The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Adopted the recommendations contained in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (March 8, 2018) from the Chief Executive Officer, Exhibition Place. 2. Directed that the recommendations in Confidential Attachment 1, and Confidential Appendices A and B to the report (March 8, 2018) from the Chief Executive Officer, Exhibition Place be released after all affected employees have been informed of the Board's decision at the discretion of the Chief Executive Officer, Exhibition Place and that the remaining portion of Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (March 8, 2018) from the Chief Executive Officer, Exhibition Place remain confidential as it involves personal matters about identifiable individuals employed by the Board.
